captureMethod: Rendered live legacy DOM in an anonymous browser with no extension, after host initialization. Original styles, tables, notice tabs, form controls and image assets retained.
sanitization: Credentials cleared; capture uses synthetic account 123456789 and masked example password.
Session URL parameters removed; CAPTCHA and audio query replaced with fixture.
Hidden fnstr replaced with fixture; explicit form association restores the live parser-associated control after DOM serialization.
Host scripts and event handlers removed; calendar iframe is inert about:blank.
Anonymous expired CAPTCHA image retained for offline visual fidelity; no live login requests or submissions are replayed.
limitations: Frozen announcements reflect the capture date.
English and non-student source variants are not recaptured.
